record.summary: Malaysia's national voluntary AI governance and ethics guidelines, launched by MOSTI in September 2024. They are built on seven AI principles: fairness; reliability, safety and control; privacy and security; inclusiveness; transparency; accountability; and pursuit of human benefit and happiness. Separate guidance is given to end users, policymakers and developers or technology providers. The document is meant to be amended as technology and ethical norms change.
record.notes: The MASTIC publication page dates the guidelines September 2024, and the MOSTI media release gives 20 September 2024 as the launch day. The National AI Action Plan 2026-2030 refers to the guidelines as issued by MOSTI in 2023, which may reflect an earlier draft; the September 2024 date of the published guidelines is used here. The guidelines call themselves a living document that MOSTI will amend over time.

verification.note: Stored: the MASTIC (MOSTI) publication page (title, publisher, Sep 2024), the full guidelines PDF (publisher, seven principles, voluntary adoption) and the MOSTI media release of 20 September 2024 (launch day, three stakeholder categories). The 'in 2023' remark on the Action Plan comes from that record's text and was not rechecked here.
